abstract: PURPOSE: To assess the long-term efficacy and toxicity of front-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy in patients with stage IIA or IIB testicular seminoma. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Untreated patients with pure seminoma of the testis after orchiectomy, with clinical stage IIA or IIB, were considered eligible for this prospective observational study. Chemotherapy consisted of either four cycles of cisplatin and etoposide or three cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin. RESULTS: Between April 1994 and March 2003, 72 patients were entered onto the study at 26 participating centers. Eighteen patients had stage IIA disease, and 54 patients had stage IIB disease. Eighty-three percent of patients achieved complete response, and 17% achieved partial response with residual mass. After a median follow-up time of 71.5 months, six patients with stage IIB disease experienced relapse, and one of these patients died as a result of seminoma. Three patients experienced non-seminoma-related deaths (two died from a further esophageal carcinoma, and one died from an upper digestive hemorrhage). The estimated 5-year progression-free survival rates for patients with stage IIA or IIB disease were 100% and 87% (95% CI, 77.5% to 97%), respectively. Five-year progression-free and overall survival rates for the whole group were 90% (95% CI, 82% to 98%) and 95% (95% CI, 89% to 100%), respectively. Severe granulocytopenia and thrombocytopenia were observed in eight and two patients, respectively. Mild to moderate emesis, stomatitis, and diarrhea were the most common nonhematologic effects. CONCLUSION: Chemotherapy is a highly effective and well-tolerated treatment for patients with stage IIA or IIB seminoma and represents an available alternative that could avoid some of the serious late effects associated with radiotherapy. Further studies focusing on long-term toxicities of different treatment modalities are needed.
abstract_ja: 目的：未治療の病期IIAまたはIIBの精巣セミノーマ患者に対する初回のシスプラチン併用化学療法の長期的な有効性と毒性を評価すること。患者と方法：精巣摘除術後で、臨床病期IIAまたはIIBの未治療の純粋セミノーマ患者を、前向き観察研究の対象とした。化学療法は、シスプラチンとエトポシドの4サイクル、またはシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンの3サイクルのいずれかとした。結果：1994年4月から2003年3月までに、26の参加施設から72例が登録された。18例が病期IIA、54例が病期IIBであった。83%の患者が完全奏効を、17%が残存腫瘤を伴う部分奏効を達成した。中央値71.5か月のフォローアップ後、病期IIBの6例が再発し、そのうち1例はセミノーマにより死亡した。セミノーマとは無関係の死亡が3例(食道癌による2例、上部消化管出血による1例)あった。病期IIAおよびIIBの患者における5年無増悪生存率はそれぞれ100%および87%(95%CI, 77.5%～97%)であった。全体の5年無増悪生存率および全生存期間(全生存率)はそれぞれ90%(95%CI, 82%～98%)および95%(95%CI, 89%～100%)であった。重度の顆粒球減少症と血小板減少症がそれぞれ8例、2例に認められた。非血液毒性としては、軽度から中等度の嘔吐、口内炎、下痢が最も多かった。結論：化学療法は病期IIAまたはIIBのセミノーマ患者に対する非常に有効で忍容性の高い治療法であり、放射線療法の重篤な晩期障害を回避しうる代替手段である。異なる治療法の長期毒性に焦点を当てたさらなる研究が必要である。
